note: A prayer scaffold, not a fixed form. Scripture is quoted live from the reader's selected public-domain / CC0 version; the connecting words are a simple, non-sectarian guide meant to be edited. Make each prayer your own.

subjects.title: Open prayer
subjects.attribute: near to all who call on You in truth
subjects.thanks: for hearing me whenever I call
subjects.petitionSelf: Hear the prayer of my heart, and draw me close to You.
subjects.petitionOther: Hear this prayer for {name}, and draw {name} close to You.

subjects.title: Peace & anxiety
subjects.attribute: the God of peace, who holds all things together
subjects.thanks: for the peace You give that the world cannot take away
subjects.petitionSelf: Quiet my anxious heart, and guard my mind with Your peace.
subjects.petitionOther: Quiet {name}'s anxious heart, and guard {name} with Your peace.

subjects.title: Healing & sickness
subjects.attribute: the LORD who heals, tender toward the hurting
subjects.thanks: for Your care over every wound of body and soul
subjects.petitionSelf: Bring healing to my body and comfort to my heart, according to Your mercy.
subjects.petitionOther: Bring healing to {name}, and comfort all who love {name}, according to Your mercy.

subjects.title: Guidance & decisions
subjects.attribute: the God who guides those who trust You
subjects.thanks: for promising wisdom to all who ask
subjects.petitionSelf: Make my path clear, and give me wisdom to walk in it.
subjects.petitionOther: Make {name}'s path clear, and give {name} wisdom to walk in it.

subjects.title: Strength & weariness
subjects.attribute: my strength when I am weak
subjects.thanks: for renewing the strength of all who wait on You
subjects.petitionSelf: Renew my strength, and carry me when I cannot go on.
subjects.petitionOther: Renew {name}'s strength, and carry {name} when the way is hard.

subjects.title: Thanksgiving & gratitude
subjects.attribute: the giver of every good and perfect gift
subjects.thanks: for Your goodness that follows me all my days
subjects.petitionSelf: Teach me to give thanks in all things and to see Your hand in my life.
subjects.petitionOther: Teach {name} to give thanks in all things and to see Your hand at work.

subjects.title: Forgiveness & confession
subjects.thanks: for cleansing and mercy that meet me again and again
subjects.petitionSelf: Forgive my sins, cleanse my heart, and create in me a right spirit.
subjects.petitionOther: Meet {name} with Your mercy, and create in {name} a clean heart.

subjects.title: Protection & fear
subjects.thanks: for watching over my going out and my coming in
subjects.petitionSelf: Shelter me from harm, and still my fears with Your presence.
subjects.petitionOther: Watch over {name}, keep {name} from harm, and still every fear.

subjects.title: Provision & work
subjects.attribute: my provider, who knows all that I need
subjects.thanks: for supplying my needs day by day
subjects.petitionSelf: Provide for my needs, bless the work of my hands, and free me from worry.
subjects.petitionOther: Provide for {name}, bless the work of {name}'s hands, and lift every burden.

subjects.title: Family & loved ones
subjects.thanks: for the gift of those I love
subjects.petitionSelf: Bless my family, guard our home, and draw us near to You.
subjects.petitionOther: Bless {name} and {name}'s household, guard their home, and draw them near to You.

subjects.title: Grief & comfort
subjects.attribute: the God of all comfort, near to the brokenhearted
subjects.petitionSelf: Comfort me in my grief, and hold me until joy returns.
subjects.petitionOther: Comfort {name} in this grief, and hold {name} until joy returns.

subjects.title: Faith & doubt
subjects.attribute: faithful, even when my faith is small
subjects.thanks: for meeting my doubts with Your faithfulness
subjects.petitionSelf: Help my unbelief, and strengthen my faith in You.
subjects.petitionOther: Help {name}'s unbelief, and strengthen {name}'s faith in You.

subjects.title: Temptation & struggle
subjects.attribute: my deliverer, who makes a way of escape
subjects.thanks: for grace to help in time of need
subjects.petitionSelf: Deliver me from temptation, and give me strength to stand.
subjects.petitionOther: Deliver {name} from temptation, and give {name} strength to stand.
